name: Source-video discovery
evidence_and_reason: Local corpus (96 Commons, 250 ANAKIN trimmed, 1,131 variants) can be searched; natural candidate pools (FVC/FIVR/VCSL/COVID) are metadata-only; no retrieval code or retrieval metric exists (only pair scoring).
limitations: retrieval evaluation missing; natural media inaccessible

name: Relationship learning
sufficiency: SUFFICIENT for controlled relationships; PARTIAL for natural
evidence_and_reason: 9928 labelled pairs in splits; parent-child recorded; ANAKIN gives 250 real edit pairs; FIVR/VCSL labels exist but without media.

name: Transformation robustness
sufficiency: SUFFICIENT coverage, thin per-type test counts
evidence_and_reason: 14 transformation types, chains to depth 3; test split has 143 variants over 7 families; baseline shows crop/mirror weakness.
limitations: per-type n small; unseen types are FFmpeg edits

name: OCR, ASR and audio analysis
evidence_and_reason: Only audio md5/envelope fingerprints; no OCR, ASR, transcripts or audio embeddings exist; caption ground truth exists for 110 variants; FVC_text_queries.csv (multilingual event titles) is unused.

name: Relationship graph
evidence_and_reason: Typed edges with direction and evidence status exist (299,875); no graph store or builder; no numeric confidence; uncertainty only via status labels.

name: Campaign investigation
evidence_and_reason: No per-post account + time + relationship evidence: 0 sharer accounts; tweet times derived; Facebook ids only; cluster table empty.

name: Evaluation
evidence_and_reason: Source-family splits (split-v2), held-out transformations, one non-learned baseline with metrics; no confidence intervals, no learned model, no retrieval eval, no time-to-detection.

name: Reporting and human review
evidence_and_reason: Evidence ledger (1,237 records) and traceable ids exist; no report generator; reviewer fields are blank; no documented footage review.
